title: A Philosophical Enquiry into the Origin of our Ideas of the Sublime and Beautiful
author: Edmund Burke
edition: Works of the Right Honourable Edmund Burke, Vol. 1 of 12 (London: John C. Nimmo, 1887); the Enquiry runs from p. 67 in this volume together with A Vindication of Natural Society and other pieces. Not on Standard Ebooks (Burke 'Essays' not in catalogue)
